svg.text: Median per push, at list prices. boxd: every machine while it was up, the server until it sleeps.
Vercel CI: $0.0035 per CPU-minute. boxd: $0.047 per vCPU-hour and $0.014 per GiB-hour, all RAM in use.
Each change on its own scale: the slower platform fills the track.
